correctness.rationale: Conditionally on the tree, B increases by 1+(z−1)z^{degree(parent)} and D increases by the root-selection indicator. Total covariance gives the stated multiplicative update and forcing (z−1)(b_n/n−a_n/n²). Substituting a_n=[n+(1−z)b_n]/(2−z) cancels the constant forcing after centering at 1/(2−z). On |z|≤ρ<1, each product factor from j≥2 has absolute value at most 1−(1−ρ)/j. The centered forcing is O_ρ(n^{−1−(1−ρ)}); the transition product gives the stated harmonic logarithm. Cauchy's formula yields each fixed-class limit, and B_n(1)=n gives the complementary covariance. As a finite cross-check only, `python3 -B /workspace/review_work/check_record5.py` independently compared 36 exact covariance evaluations using independent parent draws with full enumeration of sizes 1–9, and checked eight leaf evaluations. The frozen checker was inspected, not executed.
